title: Changing Gait Without Stumbling: Phase Tables for Walk, Trot, Pace and Bound, Turning One Into Another at a Bounded Rate, and a Switch With a Gap

artifact.note: the schedule of gaits for four legs: the phase offsets of a walk, a trot, a pace and a bound (legs in the order front left, front right, rear left, rear right); a move of a leg's offset toward another gait's at a bounded rate by the shortest way round the cycle (a phase wraps); the least number of feet on the ground while a gait is changed into another, abruptly and at a bounded rate; and the choice of gait from the speed, with a gap between the speed that changes up and the one that changes down so that it does not flap
